meta.name: PanVK Mali-G2 experimental test5 (eb32b40)
meta.description: Fixes G2 vertex DrawID preload mapping, verified with two indirect draws. Adds exact compiler error diagnostics and best-effort append logging to a pre-created Download file. Eden game launch remains under test.
meta.author: Local G2 port based on JimVulkan mali-panvk

changes: Map vertex DrawID preload to G2 R3, matching native shader descriptor and instruction capture
Record failing compiler instruction and legacy encoded word in local diagnostics
Record thread IDs and append to an existing writable Download diagnostic file
Increase loopback monitor receive buffer to the available 16 MiB

validation.drawid_reference: stock passes 256/256 pixels; test4 fails 128/256; test5 passes 256/256 for 30 frames
validation.astc_normal_reference: 3 deterministic inputs, 16 compressed blocks and 256 RGBA pixels each; byte-exact match to stock Vulkan running original Eden ASTC shader

diagnostics.append_requirement: Pre-created file must be writable by the app; UDP collection remains available

pending: Eden test5 game launch and shader loading validation
